crossRefs.note: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.
Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and…
Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons…
You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: He died at a ripe old age, full of years, riches, and honor, and his son Solomon reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
translations.asv: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
